compute_task_changes: compute the number of tasks and their change points from a task label tensor
compute_confusion_matrix: compute backward and forward transfer metrics from task labels and prediction results
compute_confusion_matrix_with_output: compute transfer metrics and write the confusion matrix and stats to a file
analyze_backward_transfer: analyze backward transfer by comparing final task accuracy against per-task diagonal accuracy
analyze_forward_transfer: analyze forward transfer by comparing cross-task accuracy against baseline predictions
